name: Schema Change
description: Modify data model, migration, field type, or event schema.

clarifying_questions.question: Is this an additive or destructive schema change?

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-SCHEMA01
  TYPE: SCHEMA:DB_ADD
  SCOPE: src/db/migrations/
  MODULES: data-layer
  RISK CAP: HIGH
  PROMISES:
    1. Up migration works → verify: migration_test
    2. Down migration works → verify: migration_test
    3. Data preserved → verify: test_passes
  STATUS: proposed
